newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.372 billion yuan from 4.0 billion yuan on Wednesday.
Traders said turnover shrank sharply because yesterday's major borrowers, short-term financial institutions, reduced their borrowing.
"State-run banks reduced their lending today and the rates will not fluctuate widely in the next few days before the end of the year," one trader said.
"If the domestic A share market continues to rise, short-term financial centres in coastal cities will increase their borrowing next week," he added.
